lataif:q33-41.siOfficial: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
lataif:q33-41.enShown: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance And exalt Him morning and afternoon

lataif:q39-53.siOfficial: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.<sup foot_note=197245>1</sup> Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
lataif:q39-53.enShown: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful

lataif:q94-5.siOfficial: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief]. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
lataif:q94-5.enShown: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease

lataif:q3-134.siOfficial: Who spend [in the cause of Allāh] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allāh loves the doers of good;
lataif:q3-134.enShown: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good

lataif:q41-34.siOfficial: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
lataif:q41-34.enShown: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend

lataif:q7-205.siOfficial: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.
lataif:q7-205.enShown: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless

lataif:q16-53.siOfficial: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
lataif:q16-53.enShown: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help

lataif:q39-10.siOfficial: Say,<sup foot_note=197236>1</sup> "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."
lataif:q39-10.enShown: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account

lataif:q16-18.siOfficial: And if you should count the favors of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
lataif:q16-18.enShown: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

lataif:q70-5.siOfficial: So be patient with gracious patience.
lataif:q70-5.enShown: So be patient with gracious patience

lataif:q14-7.siOfficial: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'"
lataif:q14-7.enShown: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe

lataif:q49-10.siOfficial: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
lataif:q49-10.enShown: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy

lataif:q11-115.siOfficial: And be patient, for indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
lataif:q11-115.enShown: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

lataif:q4-86.siOfficial: And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet [in return] with one better than it or [at least] return it [in a like manner]. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, an Accountant.
lataif:q4-86.enShown: And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet [in return] with one better than it or [at least] return it [in a like manner]. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, an Accountant

lataif:q93-11.siOfficial: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
lataif:q93-11.enShown: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]

lataif:q39-9.siOfficial: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
lataif:q39-9.enShown: Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding
